lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: O My True Lord Master, True is Your glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂੰ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too(n) paarabraham bea(n)t suaamee teree kudarat kahan na jaaee ||
lines.translation: You are the Supreme Lord God, the Infinite Lord and Master. Your creative power cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ਸਦਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachee teree vadiaaee jaa kau tudh ma(n)n vasaaee sadaa tere gun gaavahe ||
lines.translation: True is Your glorious greatness; when You enshrine it within the mind, one sings Your Glorious Praises forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਜਾ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun gaavahi jaa tudh bhaavahi sache siu chit laavahe ||
lines.translation: He sings Your Glorious Praises, when it is pleasing to You, O True Lord; he centers his consciousness on You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂੰ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਹਿ ਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis no too(n) aape melahi s guramukh rahai samaaee ||
lines.translation: One whom You unite with Yourself, as Gurmukh, remains absorbed in You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਉ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਚੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਸਚੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੧੦॥੨॥੭॥੫॥੨॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: iu kahai naanak sache mere saahibaa sachee teree vadiaaee ||10||2||7||5||2||7||
lines.translation: Thus says Nanak: O my True Lord Master, True is Your Glorious Greatness. ||10||2||7||5||2||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa chha(n)t mahalaa 4 ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, Chhant, Fourth Mehl, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨੋ ਮੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਭਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevano mai jeevan paaiaa guramukh bhaae raam ||
lines.translation: Life - I have found real life, as Gurmukh, through His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵੈ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har naamo har naam devai merai praan vasaae raam ||
lines.translation: The Lord's Name - He has given me the Lord's Name, and enshrined it within my breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam merai praan vasaae sabh sa(n)saa dookh gavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: He has enshrined the Name of the Lord, Har, Har within my breath of lfe, and all my doubts and sorrows have departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਦਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: adisat agochar gur bachan dhiaaiaa pavitr param pad paaiaa ||
lines.translation: I have meditated on the invisible and unapproachable Lord, through the Guru's Word, and I have obtained the pure, supreme status.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਨਹਦ ਧੁਨਿ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਵਾਜੇ ਗਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: anahad dhun vaajahi nit vaaje gaaee satigur baanee ||
lines.translation: The unstruck melody resounds, and the instruments ever vibrate, singing the Bani of the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਤਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਤੈ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daat karee prabh daatai jotee jot samaanee ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, God the Great Giver has given me a gift; He has blended my light into the Light. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮੁਏ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukhaa manamukh mue meree kar maaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die in their self-willed stubbornness, declaring that the wealth of Maya is theirs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਜਾਵੈ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin aavai khin jaavai duraga(n)dh maRai chit laaiaa raam ||
lines.translation: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which comes for a moment, and departs in an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਮੜੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਜਿਉ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਸੁੰਭ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: laaiaa duraga(n)dh maRai chit laagaa jiu ra(n)g kasu(n)bh dikhaaiaa ||
lines.translation: They attach their consciousness to the foul-smelling pile of filth, which is transitory, like the fading color of the safflower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਛਮਿ ਛਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਚਕੁ ਕੁਮੑਿਆਰਿ ਭਵਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin poorab khin pachham chhaae jiu chak kumhiaar bhavaaiaa ||
lines.translation: One moment, they are facing east, and the next instant, they are facing west; they continue spinning around, like the potter's wheel.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਖਾਵਹਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੰਚਹਿ ਭੋਗਹਿ ਦੁਖ ਕੀ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਵਧਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh khaavahi dukh sa(n)chahi bhogahi dukh kee biradh vadhaaee ||
lines.translation: In sorrow, they eat, and in sorrow, they gather things and try to enjoy them, but they only increase their stores of sorrow.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ਤਰੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਵੈ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bikham suhelaa tareeai jaa aavai gur saranaaee ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one easily crosses over the terrifying world-ocean, when he comes to the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਠਾਕੁਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੀਕਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਥਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa thaakuro thaakur neekaa agam athaahaa raam ||
lines.translation: My Lord, my Lord Master is sublime, unapproachable and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਾਹਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: har poojee har poojee chaahee mere satigur saahaa raam ||
lines.translation: The wealth of the Lord - I seek the wealth of the Lord, from my True Guru, the Divine Banker.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜੀ ਚਾਹੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਿਸਾਹੀ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har poojee chaahee naam bisaahee gun gaavai gun bhaavai ||
lines.translation: I seek the wealth of the Lord, to purchase the Naam; I sing and love the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨੀਦ ਭੂਖ ਸਭ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਸੁੰਨੇ ਸੁੰਨਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: need bhookh sabh parahar tiaagee su(n)ne su(n)n samaavai ||
lines.translation: I have totally renounced sleep and hunger, and through deep meditation, I am absorbed into the Absolute Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਇਕ ਭਾਤੀ ਆਵਹਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਹੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: vanajaare ik bhaatee aavahi laahaa har naam lai jaahe ||
lines.translation: The traders of one kind come and take away the Name of the Lord as their profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਆਗੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak man tan arap gur aagai jis praapat so paae ||3||
lines.translation: O Nanak, dedicate your mind and body to the Guru; one who is so destined, attains it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨਾ ਰਤਨ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਬਹੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: ratanaa ratan padaarath bahu saagar bhariaa raam ||
lines.translation: The great ocean is full of the treasures of jewels upon jewels.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: baanee gurabaanee laage tinh hath chaRiaa raam ||
lines.translation: Those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani, see them come into their hands.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਬਾਣੀ ਲਾਗੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਹਥਿ ਚੜਿਆ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurabaanee laage tinh hath chaRiaa niramolak ratan apaaraa ||
lines.translation: This priceless, incomparable jewel comes into the hands of those who are committed to the Word of the Guru's Bani.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਤੋਲਕੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har naam atolak paaiaa teree bhagat bhare bha(n)daaraa ||
lines.translation: They obtain the immeasurable Name of the Lord, Har, Har; their treasure is overflowing with devotional worship.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਵਿਰੋਲਿ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹਮ ਦੇਖਿਆ ਇਕ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਨੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: samu(n)d virol sareer ham dekhiaa ik vasat anoop dikhaaee ||
lines.translation: I have churned the ocean of the body, and I have seen the incomparable thing come into view.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੋੁਵਿੰਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਹੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: gur govi(n)d gouvi(n)d guroo hai naanak bhed na bhaaee ||4||1||8||
lines.translation: The Guru is God, and God is the Guru, O Nanak; there is no difference between the two, O Siblings of Destiny. ||4||1||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: aasaa mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Aasaa, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮੇ ਝਿਮਿ ਝਿਮਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhim jhime jhim jhim varasai a(n)mrit dhaaraa raam ||
lines.translation: Slowly, slowly, slowly, very slowly, the drops of Ambrosial Nectar trickle down.
